data.title: South Korean tycoon ordered to pay US$644m in divorce
data.description: SEOUL - A South Korean court ordered an AI chip-manufacturing tycoon on Friday to make a trimmed-down US$644 million (around 21.71 billion baht) divorce payment to his former wife.

data.title: Wildfire sends hundreds fleeing French peninsula by boat
data.description: LèGE-CAP-FERRET (FRANCE) - Hundreds of people fled by boat from a peninsula in western France on Friday, as authorities ordered it evacuated in the face of a rapidly advancing wildfire.

data.title: Spain declares national emergency over wildfires near Madrid and in Avila
data.description: MADRID — The ⁠Spanish government ⁠on Thursday night declared ​a national emergency after a series of wildfires threatened communities near Madrid ​and in the neighbouring province of ‌Avila, forcing more than 10,000 people to evacuate as firefighters struggled to contain the blazes.

data.title: Wafcon favourites Nigeria eye World Cup slot and record prize money
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - The 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon) kicks off in Morocco on Sunday with qualification for the World Cup and a record US$2million (67.5 million baht) first prize on the line.

data.title: US imposes new tariffs on 60 partners as Trump rebuilds trade agenda
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A new wave of US tariffs targeting 60 trading partners took effect on Friday, replacing an expiring global duty rolled out by President Donald Trump earlier this year.

data.title: US vows to punish Iran after Houthis strike tankers
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran and the United States vowed on Thursday to step up attacks, after Tehran's Houthi allies struck Saudi shipping and sent oil prices soaring.

data.title: Albania police teargas protesters against Trump-linked resort
data.description: TIRANA (ALBANIA) - Police used tear gas and water cannon on Thursday against protesters outside the parliament in Albania, where a tourism project linked to the Trump family has sparked outrage.

data.title: US panel says to loosen restrictions on popular peptide despite safety concerns
data.description: NEW YORK - A US review panel on Thursday recommended loosening restrictions on the much hyped peptide BPC-157, voting that specialized pharmacies be allowed to produce it despite alarm bells from medical experts over safety concerns.

data.title: Fields medal awarded to four young mathematicians
data.description: PHILADELPHIA - The Fields medal, known as the Nobel prize of mathematics, was awarded Thursday to four people -- two Chinese citizens, one American and one Canadian.

data.title: Google hit with $1 billion fine for abusing its power in Europe
data.description: LONDON — In a decision likely to intensify trans-Atlantic trade tensions, European Union (EU) regulators on Thursday hit Google with a US$1 billion fine for illegally undercutting competition through its dominance as a search engine.

data.title: Iran vows to continue strikes in spreading Mideast war
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran vowed on Thursday to keep striking the region so long as it remains under attack, as the Middle East war spread to new fronts with Tehran’s Houthi allies attacking Saudi shipping in the Red Sea.

data.title: Modi vows punishment for Indian exam scandal
data.description: NEW DELHI - Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi vowed on Thursday “stringent punishment” for those involved in exam fraud that has fuelled student anger, in his first direct comments tied to major protests challenging his government.

data.title: Thousands flee wildfires in France, Italy and Spain
data.description: ROME - Wildfires continued to sweep across swathes of Italy, France and Spain on Thursday, forcing thousands to flee from blazes fanned by scorching temperatures and strong winds.

data.title: Hundreds hospitalised in Japan heatwave ‘disaster’
data.description: TOKYO - More than 450 people received hospital treatment for heat-related issues in a single day in Tokyo — the highest number since records began 16 years ago, emergency services said on Thursday.

data.title: Candidates to lead UN set for televised debate
data.description: UNITED NATIONS - The six candidates for United Nations secretary-general will debate on Thursday in the General Assembly Hall, one week before the formal start of a selection process crucial to an organisation in deep crisis.
